name: Full-stack — Java + Node + Maven (versions pinned by the project)
description: Builds and tests a mixed Java + Node/TypeScript project: compile Java, run unit tests, run Maven, run npm/npx from one image. Carries the mise version manager, not a fixed runtime — each repo pins the exact Java, Node and Maven in a committed .mise.toml, so an update is a commit there, not a platform release, and two repos can use different versions at once. No pin falls back to the baseline (Java 21 / Node 22 / Maven 3.9). Runtimes are cached in the agent workspace and survive a respawn. Also bundles git-delta, jq and fzf. Container/Docker work is not included — use the podman-sandbox plugin.
